dedupe_keys.name: european port traffic explorer annual vessel arrivals by ship type and size at 15 major eu ports

description: This Zenodo software bundle provides a derived vessel-arrival dataset, refresh script and interactive explorer for fifteen large European ports. The provider says the source is official Eurostat maritime statistics, aggregated to closed calendar years from 2019 onward, by ship type and gross-tonnage size class. Rotterdam, Antwerp-Bruges, Hamburg, Valencia, Piraeus and other ports are named. These counts can calibrate port-call or maritime-capacity scenarios and compare traffic mix across ports. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this fixed explorer release. A limitation is that annual arrival counts do not describe berth occupation, cargo tonnage, vessel queues or inland logistics. The live explorer may update after the Zenodo release; the archived data need their own vintage check. Eurostat reuse requires source attribution alongside the Zenodo CC BY 4.0 licence. The internal ZIP structure and refresh script were not inspected or run, and no port total was independently checked.
